{{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Unholy Martyrdom}}''' - Spawns seven [[Sin]]s upon death. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Demon''' is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]], though only when summoned by the [[Reaper]]. It has a high amount of health, but it walks at an below average pace. It has the [[Burn Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], making it immune to being set on fire, immune to being stunned, only slowed down and immune to knockback. Upon death, it summons seven [[Sin]]s. ==Apperance== The '''Demon''' is a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a red skin tone and a dark red torso, waist, legs and a pair of wings made of magma. It has muscular arms and reddish-black horns with red stripes on its head. The '''Demon''' has a death animation where it will kneel and reach for the sky before flashing red and turning into ash, with its body then disassembling and fading away. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |6% |390 |- !Wave !Health |- |37 |6,890 |- |38 |7,280 |- |39 |7,670 |- |40 |8,060 |} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] are recommended against this. **As it always spawns in groups and summons groups of enemies on death, high DPS towers with splash damage capabilities, like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] can be especially useful here. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be helpful at clearing out the '''Demons''' and their [[Sin]]s. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} DemonWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January 2025 – Present) DemonDeath.gif|Death animation (22 January 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Demon.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDemon.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail9.png|'''Demon''' on the game thumbnail {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DemonLunarIndex.png|'''Demon''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The amount of [[Sin]]s spawned by the '''Demon''' upon death is a reference to the [[wp:Seven deadly sins|seven deadly sins]]. *The '''Demon''' was originally going to have 6,666 health, referencing the number [[wp:666 (number)|666]], which is famously known as the "''Number of the beast''". ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Demon''' added. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Pizza Party]]
